This is a edge type message. Edge type messages appear in the history of an object in Phabricator, showing connections to other objects being added or removed from that object. See some examples at https://phabricator.wmcloud.org/feed/query/Xfz4YCHgYFVi/#R

* $1 - the user who performed the action (unfortunately Phabricator does not support GENDER here)
* $2 - the total number of things added and modified (sum of $4 and $6 - for PLURAL if warranted, not needed in English)
* $3 - the number of things removed (for PLURAL if warranted, not needed in English)
* $4 - a list of things removed
* $5 - the number of things modified (for PLURAL if warranted, not needed in English)
* $6 - a list of things modified
